instruction.name: movgr2frh.w
instruction.description: Move the low 32 bits of rj into the high 32 bits of fd.

experiments.name: high-unroll memory-assisted chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 1; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 0' --asm 'movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; fst.d $f0, $r12, 0; ld.d $r4, $r12, 0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'
experiments.notes: 13.02 cycles minus 11.04 (10.04 FPR-store -> GPR-load forwarding + 1 add.d) = 1.98 cycles, reported as 2.

latencies.notes: Writing the high half costs 2 cycles, one more than movgr2fr.d/w. The instruction retires as 2 uops, but throughput is still 1 CPI.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: fd -> fd chain: writing the high half merges with the existing low half, so the old fd value is a real source.

latencies.notes: fd -> fd chain: writing the high half merges with the existing low half, so the old fd value is a real source. Raw measurement was 1.07; the residual is a systematic +0.03..0.1 calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread. Raw slope-method measurement was 1.00; the value is 1 cycle(s) and any earlier range was a rounding artifact.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfc --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.00 cycles. Extra counters per instruction (normalized by 8 lanes): 0xfc=1.00.

notes: High-half GPR->FPR move. Retires as 2 uops; write latency is 2 cycles versus 1 cycle for movgr2fr.d/w. Round trip with movfrh2gr.s is 5 cycles. Throughput is 1 CPI.
